signals.text: Revenue grew 48% a year over 3 years vs 54% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 56% vs revenue at 48%: operating leverage is showing.
Operating margin expanded 84 bps in 3 years (15.1% → 15.9%).
Working-capital days lengthened by 26 days in 3 years (107 → 133).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was -63% of reported profit: profits are not converting to cash, a red flag.
Free cash flow was negative in 5 of the last 5 years: capex is running ahead of cash generation.

guidance.statement: We plan to capex about INR300 crores for OSAT and INR300 crores for PCB in FY27.
guidance.quote: Our current goal is to capex at about INR300 crores for OSAT and PCB

guidance.quote: we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores

guidance.statement: We are targeting revenue growth at twice the market growth rate for FY27.
guidance.quote: revenue growth, we have committed the 2x of the market growth.

guidance.statement: We are on track to spend INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and INR250 crores for EMS.
guidance.quote: we said we will be funding for this capex for this year is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and about INR250 crores for EMS business.

delivered.statement: Total revenue for Q1 FY27 was INR946 crores, reflecting 40% year-on-year growth.
EBITDA for the quarter was INR147.6 crores, translating to a 15.6% margin and 31% YoY growth.
The robust order book stood at around INR9,000 crores at the end of Q1 FY27.
Standalone EMS business revenue grew 53% year-on-year to INR639 crores.
Overseas entities revenue grew 327% year-on-year to INR102 crores in Q1 FY27.
Smart metering business sales declined 12% year-on-year to INR204 crores.

calls.tone: Optimistic on core EMS growth and long-term strategy, but cautious on component inflation and working capital.

pushback.gist: Analysts pressed on the sub-optimal returns, high receivables, and options to divest the smart metering business.
Concerned about gross margin compression given sharp component price hikes and supply chain lead times.
Pressed on negative cash flow from operations and a significant inventory build-up.

delivered.statement: FY26 total revenue stood at INR3,626.4 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 33.2%.
FY26 EBITDA was INR5,741 million with an EBITDA margin of 15.8% and PAT of INR3,639 million.
Q4 FY26 total revenue stood at INR12,426 million, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 26%.
Q4 FY26 operational EBITDA came to INR1,937 million with a 15.6% margin and PAT of INR912 million.
Stand-alone EMS working capital days reduced from 83 days in FY24 to 53 days in FY26.
Stand-alone EMS cash flow was INR250 crores positive for FY26 compared to INR65 crores last year.

calls.tone: Optimistic about long-term strategy and new platforms, but defensive regarding past guidance misses and working capital.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the wide variance and credibility of management guidance versus actual delivery.
Repeated concerns raised over the large negative operational cash flow and ballooning receivables.
Intense questioning regarding mounting receivables and installation delays in the smart metering business.
Pushback on previous targets for OSAT and PCB production versus current lower projections.

guidance.statement: Net working capital is expected to be around 70 to 85 days.

guidance.quote: you can take broadly in this year, maybe about another INR400-odd crores of capex will be spent.

delivered.statement: 9-month total revenue stood at INR23,837 million, reflecting 37% year-on-year growth.
Operational EBITDA for the 9-month period was INR3,778 million with 15.9% margin, up 190 bps.
Profit after tax reached INR2,726 million, representing a PAT margin of 11.4%.
The order book stood at around INR90,000 million pending execution.

calls.tone: Confident in long-term strategy and $1 billion target, acknowledging short-term execution hiccups and project deferrals.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the widening gap between strong order inflows and actual revenue execution.
Analysts pressed management on elevated inventory and receivable days and steps to reduce them.
Queries were raised regarding revenue sustainability and debtors in the smart metering business.

guidance.quote: Second thing is that with regard to PCB, the current plan includes only capex of 14 billion for which the balance requirement is 3.2 billion and up central government subsidy of about 3 billion.
